name: SDCLEARS-the-first-broken-the-last
old: const slot = slotRaw == null || String(slotRaw).trim() === '' ? '(SELECT MIN(slot) FROM sd_kills)' : sdSlot(slotRaw);
new: const slot = slotRaw == null || String(slotRaw).trim() === '' ? '(SELECT MAX(slot) FROM sd_kills)' : sdSlot(slotRaw);
note: The run left empty would name the latest Hollow broken, not the first - Mac's ask answered with the wrong group.

name: SDCLEARS-another-slots-names-mixed-in
old: return `SELECT k.slot, p.handle AS name, k.earned, k.lv, k.title, k.aura, k.at FROM sd_kills k JOIN players p ON p.id = k.account WHERE k.slot = ${slot} ORDER BY k.at, p.handle_lc;`;
new: return `SELECT k.slot, p.handle AS name, k.earned, k.lv, k.title, k.aura, k.at FROM sd_kills k JOIN players p ON p.id = k.account ORDER BY k.at, p.handle_lc;`;
note: Every Hollow's breakers would be read as one group's.

name: SDCLEARS-the-claims-by-name-alone
old: return `SELECT k.slot, p.handle AS name, k.earned, k.lv, k.title, k.aura, k.at FROM sd_kills k JOIN players p ON p.id = k.account WHERE k.slot = ${slot} ORDER BY k.at, p.handle_lc;`;
new: return `SELECT k.slot, p.handle AS name, k.earned, k.lv, k.title, k.aura, k.at FROM sd_kills k JOIN players p ON p.id = k.account WHERE k.slot = ${slot} ORDER BY p.handle_lc;`;
note: The names would no longer read in the order they claimed.

name: SDCLEARS-the-tie-by-case
old: return `SELECT k.slot, p.handle AS name, k.earned, k.lv, k.title, k.aura, k.at FROM sd_kills k JOIN players p ON p.id = k.account WHERE k.slot = ${slot} ORDER BY k.at, p.handle_lc;`;
new: return `SELECT k.slot, p.handle AS name, k.earned, k.lv, k.title, k.aura, k.at FROM sd_kills k JOIN players p ON p.id = k.account WHERE k.slot = ${slot} ORDER BY k.at, p.handle;`;
note: Two claims in one second would sort every capital before every lower case letter - 'Vex' before 'ana'.

name: SDCLEARS-the-first-claim-the-last
old: return 'SELECT slot, COUNT(*) AS fighters, MIN(at) AS first_at FROM sd_kills GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot;';
new: return 'SELECT slot, COUNT(*) AS fighters, MAX(at) AS first_at FROM sd_kills GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot;';
note: A late claim (a guest that registered a day on) would move when the Hollow reads as broken.

name: SDCLEARS-the-slot-unchecked
